fact: The Ministry's 2019 roadmap, reporting its 2018 HIS assessment, states that it is not clear how much of the health budget goes to the health information system, that UNAIDS, PEPFAR and the Global Fund are the three major donors funding it through implementing partners, and sets 'one Integrated DHIS2 system as the default reporting system' as an intervention for 2020-2025.
title: Botswana Health Data Collaborative Roadmap 2020-2025
